question: Year And month sales
sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
        ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
        END AS "Financial Year",
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") - 3
        ELSE MONTH(OINV."DocDate") + 9
    END AS "Financial Month",
    WEEK(OINV."DocDate") AS "Week",
    OINV."CardCode"       AS "Customer Code",
    OINV."CardName"       AS "Customer Name",
    OCRG."GroupName"      AS "Customer Group",
    INV1."ItemCode"       AS "Item Code",
    INV1."Dscription"     AS "Item Description",
    SUM(INV1."Quantity")  AS "Total Quantity",
    OINV."DocCur"         AS "Currency Code",
    SUM(INV1."TotalFrgn") AS "Total Amount FC",
    SUM(INV1."LineTotal") AS "Total Amount INR"
FROM "OINV" OINV
INNER JOIN "INV1" INV1 ON OINV."DocEntry" = INV1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN "OCRD" CRD ON OINV."CardCode" = CRD."CardCode"
INNER JOIN "OCRG" OCRG ON CRD."GroupCode" = OCRG."GroupCode"
WHERE
OINV."CANCELED" = 'N'
    AND OCRG."GroupType" = 'C'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM "ORIN" T3
        INNER JOIN "RIN1" T4 ON T3."DocEntry" = T4."DocEntry"
        WHERE
            T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
            AND T4."BaseType" = 13
            AND T4."BaseEntry" = OINV."DocEntry"
            AND T4."BaseLine" = INV1."LineNum"
            )
            AND (
                CASE
            WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
            ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
            END
    ) IN (
        CASE
            WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
            ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
            END,
            CASE
            WHEN MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) >= 4 THEN YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 1
            ELSE YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
            END
    )
GROUP BY
    CASE
    WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(OINV."DocDate")
    ELSE YEAR(OINV."DocDate") - 1
    END,
    CASE
        WHEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") >= 4 THEN MONTH(OINV."DocDate") - 3
        ELSE MONTH(OINV."DocDate") + 9
    END,
    WEEK(OINV."DocDate"),
    OINV."CardCode",
    OINV."CardName",
    OCRG."GroupName",
    INV1."ItemCode",
    INV1."Dscription",
    OINV."DocCur"
    ORDER BY
    "Financial Year" ASC,
    "Financial Month" ASC,
    "Week" ASC,
    "Customer Code" ASC,
    "Item Code" ASC

question: INVENTORY OPENING AND CLOSING REPORT QTY AND VALUE WISE
sql:
SELECT
    T0."ItemCode",
    T0."ItemName",
    T1."ItmsGrpNam" AS "ItemGroup",
    T0."InvntryUom" AS "UOM",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" < '2025-04-01' THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "OpeningQty",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" < '2025-04-01' THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "OpeningValue",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND A."TransType" IN (18,20) THEN A."InQty"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "PurchaseQty",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND A."TransType" IN (18,20) THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "PurchaseValue",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND A."TransType" IN (60,21) THEN A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "IssueQty",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' AND A."TransType" IN (60,21) THEN -A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "IssueValue",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" <= '2026-03-31' THEN A."InQty" - A."OutQty"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "ClosingQty",
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN A."DocDate" <= '2026-03-31' THEN A."TransValue"
        ELSE 0
    END) AS "ClosingValue"
FROM OITM T0
INNER JOIN OITB T1 ON T1."ItmsGrpCod" = T0."ItmsGrpCod"
LEFT JOIN OINM A ON A."ItemCode" = T0."ItemCode" AND A."DocDate" <= '2026-03-31'
WHERE T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'
GROUP BY
    T0."ItemCode", T0."ItemName", T1."ItmsGrpNam", T0."InvntryUom"
HAVING
    SUM(CASE WHEN A."DocDate" <= '2026-03-31' THEN IFNULL(A."InQty",0) - IFNULL(A."OutQty",0) ELSE 0 END) <> 0
    OR SUM(CASE WHEN A."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY T0."ItemCode"

question: Consumption report Consumables Group Wise Week & Month
sql:
SELECT
    T3."ItmsGrpNam",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" = '2026-03-31' THEN T1."Quantity"
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Daily Quantity",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" = '2026-03-31' THEN (T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice")
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Daily Total Amount",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_DAYS('2026-03-31', -6) AND '2026-03-31' THEN T1."Quantity"
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Weekly Quantity",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_DAYS('2026-03-31', -6) AND '2026-03-31' THEN (T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice")
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Weekly Total Amount",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH('2026-03-31')
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR('2026-03-31') THEN T1."Quantity"
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Monthly Quantity",
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") = MONTH('2026-03-31')
            AND YEAR(T0."DocDate") = YEAR('2026-03-31') THEN (T1."Quantity" * T1."StockPrice")
            ELSE 0
        END) AS "Monthly Total Amount"
FROM
    OIGE T0
INNER JOIN
    IGE1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
INNER JOIN
    OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
INNER JOIN
    OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
WHERE
    T2."ItmsGrpCod" NOT IN (164, 160, 173, 174, 162, 172, 175, 176, 177, 178, 179, 180, 181, 182, 183, 184, 185, 186, 187, 188, 189, 190, 191)
GROUP BY
    T3."ItmsGrpNam"
HAVING
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" = '2026-03-31' THEN T1."Quantity"
            ELSE 0
        END) > 0 OR
    SUM(CASE
            WHEN T0."DocDate" BETWEEN ADD_DAYS('2026-03-31', -6) AND '2026-03-31' THEN T1."Quantity"

question: Inventory Minimum & Maximum level
sql:
SELECT
                T0."ItemCode",
                T0."ItemName",
                T1."WhsCode",
                T1."OnHand",
                T1."MinStock"     AS "Min Level",
                T1."MaxStock"     AS "Max Level",
                T1."MinOrder"     AS "Reorder Qty",
                CASE
                    WHEN T1."OnHand" = 0 THEN 'BLACK - No Stock'
                    WHEN T1."OnHand" < T1."MinStock" THEN 'RED - Critically Low'
                    WHEN T1."OnHand" <= (T1."MinStock" + T1."MinOrder") THEN 'YELLOW - Order Now'
                    WHEN T1."OnHand" <= T1."MaxStock" THEN 'GREEN - Stable'
                    ELSE 'PURPLE - Over Stock'
                END AS "Stock Status"
            FROM OITW T1
            INNER JOIN OITM T0
                ON T0."ItemCode" = T1."ItemCode"
            WHERE
                T0."InvntItem" = 'Y'
                AND (
                    T1."OnHand" <> 0
                    OR T1."MinStock" > 0
                    OR T1."MaxStock" > 0
                )
            ORDER BY T0."ItemCode"

        FROM OINV T0

        INNER JOIN OITM T2 ON T1."ItemCode" = T2."ItemCode"
        INNER JOIN OITB T3 ON T2."ItmsGrpCod" = T3."ItmsGrpCod"
        WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'

        GROUP BY

                WHEN MONTH(T0."DocDate") >= 4 THEN YEAR(T0."DocDate")
                ELSE YEAR(T0."DocDate") - 1
            END,
            T3."ItmsGrpNam",
            T0."CardCode",
            T0."CardName"
    )
    SELECT
        A."Fiscal Year" AS "Current Year",
        A."Item Group",
        A."Customer Code",
        A."Customer Name",
        COALESCE(A."Total Qty", 0) AS "Current Year Qty",
        COALESCE(A."Total Sales", 0) AS "Current Year Sales",
        COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) AS "Previous Year Qty",
        COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) AS "Previous Year Sales",
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Qty", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Qty" - B."Total Qty") / NULLIF(B."Total Qty", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "Qty Growth/Decline (%)",
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(B."Total Sales", 0) = 0 THEN 100
        ELSE ROUND((A."Total Sales" - B."Total Sales") / NULLIF(B."Total Sales", 0) * 100, 2)
    END AS "Sales Growth/Decline (%)"
    FROM SalesData A
    LEFT JOIN SalesData B ON A."Fiscal Year" = B."Fiscal Year" + 1
        AND A."Item Group" = B."Item Group"
        AND A."Customer Code" = B."Customer Code"
    WHERE A."Fiscal Year" = '2025'

                ELSE 0
            END

        -

                THEN IFNULL(T1."Credit",0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )

sql:
SELECT
            T5."DocEntry" AS "PO DocEntry",
            T5."DocNum" AS "PO DocNum",
            T4."LineNum" AS "PO LineNum",
            T5."DocDate",
            TO_VARCHAR (T5."DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Date",
            TO_VARCHAR (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS "PO Item Delivery Date",
            T4."ItemCode" AS "Item Code",
            T4."Dscription" AS "Item Description",
            COALESCE(T4."Quantity", 0) AS "PO Qty",
            GH."DocEntry" AS "Gate DocEntry",
            GH."DocNum" AS "Gate DocNum",
            GL."LineId" AS "Gate LineNum",
            COALESCE(TO_VARCHAR (GH."U_UTL_DocDate", 'DD-MM-YYYY'), 'Pending') AS "Gate Entry Date",
            COALESCE(GL."U_UTL_QTY", 0) AS "Gate Inward Qty",
            COALESCE(GU."U_NAME", 'N/A') AS "Gate Created By",
            CASE
                WHEN GH."DocEntry" IS NULL THEN 'Pending Gate Inward'
                WHEN GH."U_UTL_DocDate" <= COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate") THEN 'Good'
                ELSE 'Delay by ' || TO_VARCHAR (DAYS_BETWEEN (COALESCE(T4."ShipDate", T5."DocDueDate"), GH."U_UTL_DocDate")) || ' days'
            END AS "Gate_SLA_Status"
        FROM
            "POR1" T4
            INNER JOIN "OPOR" T5 ON T4."DocEntry" = T5."DocEntry"
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_GIN1" GL ON GL."U_UTL_BASENTR" = T4."DocEntry"
            AND GL."U_UTL_BASELINE" = T4."LineNum"
            LEFT JOIN "@UTL_GE_OGIN" GH ON GH."DocEntry" = GL."DocEntry"
            AND GH."Canceled" = 'N'
            LEFT JOIN "OUSR" GU ON GH."UserSign" = GU."USERID"
        WHERE
            T5."CANCELED" = 'N'
            AND T5."DocDate" BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
        ORDER BY
            T5."DocDate",
            T5."DocNum",
            T4."LineNum",
            GH."DocNum"

question: On-time Delivery
sql:
SELECT
        T3."DocDate" AS "Posting Date",
        T0."CardCode" AS "Vendor Code",
        T0."CardName" AS "Vendor Name",
        COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry") AS "Total Deliveries",
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), T3."DocDate") <= 0
            THEN T0."DocEntry"
        END) AS "On-Time Deliveries",
        ROUND(
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(IFNULL(T1."ShipDate", T0."DocDueDate"), T3."DocDate") <= 0
                THEN T0."DocEntry"
            END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT T0."DocEntry"), 0),
            2
        ) AS "On-Time Delivery Rate %"
    FROM OPOR T0
    INNER JOIN POR1 T1 ON T0."DocEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
    INNER JOIN PDN1 T2 ON T2."BaseType" = 22
                    AND T2."BaseEntry" = T1."DocEntry"
                    AND T2."BaseLine" = T1."LineNum"
    INNER JOIN OPDN T3 ON T2."DocEntry" = T3."DocEntry"
    WHERE T0."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T3."CANCELED" = 'N'
        AND T3."DocDate" Between '2025-04-01' AND '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY
        T3."DocDate",
        T0."CardCode",
        T0."CardName"
    ORDER BY
        T3."DocDate" DESC,
        "On-Time Delivery Rate %" ASC
